PLS against the ratio of the design (size weights)
Simulated null data: one group's annotation profile 1.5–4 times as far out as the others, on the largest, the smallest or a random group (14,400 data sets).
Dashed line: the nominal rate, 0.05. Bands: 95% intervals per bin of the ratio. Grey: the range in which describe() gives no warning. Exchangeable weights ∝ 1/√(τ² + σ²_w / n_m).
Colour: weighting (blue size, orange equal, green exchangeable). Line: test (solid PLS, dashed correlation, dotted Mantel). In c, hollow markers: M = 20; filled: M = 50.
